## Product Owner authorization — AP01 + AP04 bounded evidence review (10 November 2026)

The Product Owner replied **"يلا"** to the explicitly proposed next step: (1) retain **Violet × Apricot A — Balanced as a preferred AP04 candidate**, and (2) request from Codex an **authentic-font Typography Proof for AP01** before font or token approval. This is **review/evidence authorization only**, NOT a final typography/color/Brand V2/Design System approval.

### Current authoritative baseline — verify again before execution
- Repository: `abuhmaid28/egyhealth360`.
- Existing completed-but-unmerged **Draft PR #101** and issue #100. At authorization, base/main `5355ae5b12bb86ed2c05f70fcadd77eadcd7bde3`, PR head `81ea915d10c4ad83578465dcd8b2d26d69d1b6fe`; confirm no newer head or superseding decision.
- DP01 Arabic clearance and DP02 *tagline-free Primary Lockups* are explicitly owner-accepted. **Preserve all their source-exact assets byte-for-byte.** Never reintroduce the tagline, alter its original SVG paths, or touch the original #96/#97 branches.
- Current foundation docs are candidates, not accepted final font specification: `docs/brand-identity-v2/TYPOGRAPHY.md` on #97; review candidates and archived evidence in `docs/brand-source-exact-100/` on #101.
- `AGENTS.md`, accepted content/Arabic conventions, `docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md`, `docs/FOUNDATION_CHARTER.md` and `docs/SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md` remain binding. Existing accepted time convention must not silently change; demonstration-only time strings must not be interpreted as policy.

### Narrow work authorized
Use the **same existing issue-scoped branch and Draft PR #101** for a **separately labeled AP01/AP04 evidence-only appendix** within `docs/brand-source-exact-100/ap01-ap04-review/` (or clear equivalent), rather than spawning another parallel implementation PR. Preserve the previous candidate and its approval evidence as historical exact-head snapshots. Add only small, self-contained HTML/CSS/demo content, evidence and docs; no production imports/integration.

**AP01 — Real typography proof**
1. Recreate representative **Patient mobile** and **Doctor desktop** text-dense Web/PWA screens in both **AR RTL + EN LTR**, **dark + light**, plus tablet width, using ONLY synthetic generic patient/provider/appointment text with no personal data or clinical advice. Cover headings, Arabic month/date, appointments, actions, forms, medical information labels, error/empty states, labels, tooltips and mixed Latin digits.
2. Compare **Inter** (English 400/500/600/700) + **IBM Plex Sans Arabic** (real 400 and real 600) against one reasonable genuinely distinct Arabic UI fallback, e.g. **Noto Sans Arabic** at verified real 400/600. Do not assume an existing `plex-arabic-regular.ttf` file is semibold. Load real licensed local assets with documented origin/hash/license. No silent Google Fonts network dependency, hidden fallback, simulated bold, synthetic italic, CSS stretching or substituted screenshot labels.
3. Publish a font identity/provenance audit (font family + PostScript name + OS/2 weight or variable axes, file SHA-256, full license/OFL). Capture actual rendered font checks incl. failed network/fallback detection; `document.fonts.check` alone is insufficient. If real semibold cannot be obtained or verified, explicitly mark AP01 blocked instead of passing synthetic 600.
4. Compare visual parity between scripts, line heights, readability at real sizes, numerals/RTL, diacritics, dense tables and 200% text scaling; do not modify approved SVG wordmark, whose outlined font origin remains historically approximate.

**AP04 — Candidate Color Role Audit**
1. Use the owner-preferred candidate: dark bg `#10121D`, dark card `#1D2030`, elevated `#262A3C`, ink `#F6F2FF`, primary dark-mode violet `#A78BFA`, apricot accent `#FFB88B`; light bg `#F8F7FB`, card `#FFFFFF`, ink `#17142B`, primary light-mode violet `#6240B8`. These are **starting candidates, not frozen system tokens**.
2. Derive and validate foreground/on-accent, secondary ink, borders, inputs, secondary CTA, focus, hover, disabled and chart text with exact HEX and measured pairs. Distinguish visually subtle decorative borders from required 3:1 non-text boundaries. Avoid unnecessary accent saturation, orange warning assumptions, or purple in clinical semantic states.
3. Review form errors/warnings/success and medical statuses **as separate semantic placeholders**, no made-up clinical meanings, diagnosis or change to existing clinical contracts.
4. WCAG 2.2 text >=4.5:1 for ordinary text, meaningful non-text boundaries >=3:1, visible keyboard focus, and real light/dark combinations; disclose incomplete system-level WCAG coverage.

**Proof/validation**
- Same responsive Web/PWA design, not a native phone UI; screenshot matrix 320/390/768/1024/1440 CSS px, AR/EN, dark/light, Patient/Doctor; 200% computed text AND native browser zoom evidence when feasible; keyboard/RTL/browser asset/network-error checks.
- Evidence must differentiate real font loading from fallback; explicitly report every unsupported platform and actual physical/PWA installation untested.
- Independent second review focusing on font identity/weight, Arabic letter forms and dense content, color-role contrast and screenshot truth; report any aesthetic concerns independently of measured compliance.
- One small documentation appendix with comparisons, exact font provenance, color-pair matrix, screenshot links, QA summary, open issues and a concise **owner choice recommendation**. No claim of final AP01/AP04 closure until Product Owner explicitly approves.

### Exclusions/controls
- NO runtime `apps/web` or backend changes; no dependency or CI-config changes; no database/API/schema/migrations/auth/privacy/clinical/security edits; no deployment, merge, auto-merge, PR ready transition, ownership policy amendments or PWA manifest/service-worker work.
- Do not replace or alter source-exact primary logo artwork/DP01/DP02 decisions. AP02/AP03/AP05 remain open; test designs do not establish rights/trademark clearance or device-installed behavior.
- Run relevant tests and required exact-new-head CI if a new commit is pushed to the existing Draft PR, then report **actual** status; no early PASS claims.

### Output/handoff
Keep one branch / same Draft PR #101, with separate review appendix and 5 checkpoints: baseline; font provenance; AR/EN typography evidence; color matrix + responsive proof; independent review / exact-head CI / owner decision. Exact files changed, base/head, preserved previous assets, all limits and open AP gates. **Stop at owner review; do not merge or deploy.**

**Model:** capable coding agent with High reasoning. No further routine owner question needed within this scope.

foundation.content:
# Typography foundation

Recommendation, not final typography adoption or a runtime change. Current SVG wordmarks are preserved outlines from PR #96 and do not depend on fonts at render time.

## Family and approximation status

| Context | Recommendation / current evidence | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| English brand | Inter; reconstruction uses weight 800 for name and 450 for English tagline | Board lists Inter / IBM Plex Sans (EN), not exact source font/weight files. Horizontal fit and spacing were approximated. No exact-font claim. |
| English product UI | Inter 400 body, 500 labels, 600 subheads, 700 primary headings | Existing free repository family. Proposed hierarchy only; avoid heavy brand weight for dense clinical text. |
| Arabic brand and UI | IBM Plex Sans Arabic, 400 body and 600 headings/labels | Board lists family; reconstruction outlines use 600, shaped with HarfBuzz and fitted. Exact glyph/weight/spacing match remains unverified. |

Inter and IBM Plex Sans Arabic binaries/notices are copied byte-for-byte from PR #96 into [assets](assets/). OFL notices: [Inter](assets/Inter-OFL.txt), [Plex](assets/plex-arabic-OFL.txt). Neither font recommendation conveys ownership of the logo artwork. No paid font or remote font request is introduced.

## Suggested hierarchy for later prototypes

Sizes are CSS-pixel starting ranges, not frozen tokens. Match perceived prominence between scripts rather than forcing equal glyph height. Preserve room for Arabic marks and dots.

| Role | English | Arabic | Application |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display / brand presentation | 32–40 / 700 | 32–40 / 600 | Marketing/brand board, not every clinical screen. |
| Page title | 24–32 / 700 | 24–32 / 600 | One clear page/task title. |
| Section heading | 18–22 / 600 | 18–22 / 600 | Source/task groupings without excessive visual weight. |
| Body | 16 / 400 | 16–18 / 400 | Care explanations and ordinary content. |
| UI labels | 14–16 / 500–600 | 14–16 / 600 | Short actions and labels with explicit objects. |
| Secondary metadata | 14 / 400 | 14–16 / 400 | Keep readable; never hide clinical consequence in tiny type. |

Start English body line-height around 1.5–1.65 and Arabic around 1.7–1.9. These are UI-text recommendations, not permission to apply CSS line-height to outlined logo artwork. Avoid Arabic letter spacing, fixed-height clipping and forced uppercase equivalents. Isolate `EgyHealth 360` and `360` in mixed RTL prose; preserve logical reading order and Latin digits under accepted content policy. Font weight alone must not communicate clinical status.

## Known Arabic wordmark fit debt — DP01

In the current artwork, final ya dots in **إيجي** collide visually with the line below. The owner explicitly defers this as non-blocking for the foundation. It remains visible in copied lockups; this sprint does not claim to fix it. A later authorized correction should adjust interline spacing/baseline/type fit with current wording intact, preserve the selected symbol and compare EN/AR desktop/mobile at intended size. Confirm separated dots, unclipped marks and balanced bilingual prominence before approving the revised wordmark.

Current Arabic tagline **رعاية متكاملة حولك** is reference-only pending a professional Egyptian Arabic rewrite (DP02). Do not use it as a canonical translation in new product copy. No replacement slogan is proposed here. Exact source typography, local glossy materials and 16px detail loss remain disclosed concerns; see [register](DEFERRED_POLISH.md).
